title: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout
titleEnglish: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout
titleNative: 異世界美少女受肉おじさんと
synonyms: เกิดใหม่ต่างโลก เพื่อนผมน่ารักโฮกเลยครับ
synopsis: Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! When Jinguji angrily demands that they be returned home and go back to normal, they get cursed, and the only way out is for them to go on a quest and defeat the demon king. But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Ranked 19th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title: Game Sekai de Mamono ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore, Zense de Oshi datta Heroine wo Hirotteshimau
titleRomaji: Game Sekai de Mamono ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore, Zense de Oshi datta Heroine wo Hirotteshimau
titleNative: ゲーム世界で魔物に転生してしまった俺、前世で推しだったヒロインを拾ってしまう
synonyms: I Reincarnated as a Monster in a Game World, and Picked Up the Heroine Who Was My Oshi in My Previous Life
synopsis: When I woke up, I had reincarnated into the world of a game I played in my past life. And what's more, as a monster that's hostile to humanity! It couldn't be helped, so I just lived quietly so humans wouldn't find me, but... The heroine, Noa, who was my oshi in my past life, had collapsed near my home!! After I protected and nursed her, my oshi gave me the name "Rei", so I decided to follow and protect Noa as my oshi for life. I meet other characters from the game too, and I'm watching over Noa's growth, but... the real Noa seems to be the type who's a bit clingy and has a... "heavy" love? This is the story of me, reincarnated as a monster, somehow overcoming hardships together with my beloved oshi. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

titleNative: 闭嘴恶龙我不想再跟你带孩子了
synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand. He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer. But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

synonyms: The World's Most 'Cutest' is Amamiya-san, and the Second is Me.
synopsis: Hikari is a popular model nicknamed the “Cutest Girl in the World,” but behind that gorgeous female façade is an ordinary high school boy named Harema Kouki! Since his model self is so adorable, Kouki never really finds other girls cute…until one day, when he realizes his plain and boring classmate, Amamiya-san, is actually cuter than he is! A high school rom-com between an overconfident diva and a diamond in the rough! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: JIN: Kakutoha Oden
synonyms: Jin: Legend of the Dipper Style Destruction King
synopsis: In the not-too-distant future... In a society where corruption has spread and dreams and hopes have disappeared, an illegal, no-rules underground fighting sport called "Yaoyorozu" has thrived. Brutal street fights are waged anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and human desire. Jin Matsuya, a delinquent who repeatedly steals from the city, gets caught up in the violence. However, his qualities as a fighter are overwhelming... A new generation of spectacular battle action begins, where an extraordinary monster destroys everything! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleRomaji: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo na Kimura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
titleEnglish: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleNative: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛 ～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Namaiki Asahi-chan wo Wakarasetai
titleNative: ナマイキ旭ちゃんをわからせたい
synonyms: I Wanna Set This Cocky Asahi-chan Straight
synopsis: Ryou is in his last year of high school, and he's enjoying his otaku life to the fullest — except for a certain girl who's really getting on his nerves. She goes to his school and she's none other than his cocky two-year younger childhood-friend, Asahi-chan! Though she's suppose to be his kouhai, she's always teasing him whenever she gets the chance! On the other hand, if she gets teased back, she starts acting like "you can't say anything mean to me because I'm a cute girl." Furthermore, she's "afraid of people with practically no friends who can't be honest with their feelings." Someday, somehow, someone has to set this cocky Asahi-chan straight! (Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)
